bank_name.description: Name of the bank associated with the bank account.

expected_debit_date.description: Estimated date to debit the customer's bank account. A date string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fingerprint.description: Uniquely identifies this particular bank account. You can use this attribute to check whether two bank accounts are the same.

institution_number.description: Institution number of the bank account

last4.description: Last four digits of the bank account number.

mandate.description: ID of the mandate used to make this payment.

transit_number.description: Transit number of the bank account.
